title: THE PELICAN RUNS TRUE
style: Australian coastal groove rock, 108 BPM, elastic melodic bassline driving the track, tight rim-click verses, snare opens in chorus, muted rhythm guitar chops in verses, clean chorus guitar lift, subtle baritone sax-style melodic counterline, warm analog production, no distortion grit, confident male vocal low register, smooth phrasing, restrained verses expanding into open-air chorus, stereo ocean ambience intro only, outro instrumental fade with bass lead
lyrics:
[INTRO – bass + rim click]

[HOOK – Immediate]
The Pelican runs true
Western blue
Captain at the wheel
Sees it through

[VERSE 1]
Malaga light
Roller door rise
River glass calm
Early skies

Hands on throttle
Knows the line
Reads the tide
Like a sign

[PRE-CHORUS]
From Swan River bend
To Rottnest sand
Every mile
Planned by hand

[CHORUS – Lift]
The Pelican runs true
Every crew
Forty-eight strong
Moving through

From city lights
To open sea
Western water
Carries me

[VERSE 2]
Brandon checks
Fuel and sound
Deck set clean
Bass rolling round

BYO cold
BBQ flame
Owner run
That’s the name

[BRIDGE – bass spotlight]
No drift
No doubt
When Pete calls turn
We’re already out

[FINAL CHORUS – Extended]
The Pelican runs true
Indian blue
Captain steady
Knows what to do

[OUTRO – bass lead fade]
